title: The Radio Towers (horror element)
description:
Adds radio towers to Minecraft using Simple Radio.
this is the horror version
body:
## The Radio Towers (horror version)


This modification introduces Radio Towers to the Minecraft environment. 

These structures serve dual functions, providing both decorative elements and facilitating communication within the game. 

This mod is particularly suited for horror-themed modpacks.

### Acknowledgments

Special gratitude is extended to D3ve14 for his significant contributions to this mod, particularly regarding the development of the structures. Exploration of his other modifications is highly recommended.


### You must downlound 2 mods for this mod to work

1. [horror-element mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/horror-element-mod)

2. [simple radio](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-radio)
